input-field.name: webhookSecret
input-field.label: Webhook signing secret
Webhook-Signaturschlüssel
input-field.helpText: The secret your provider signs delivery reports with, posted to /notifications/webhook. For Termii this is its API key. Inbound webhooks are rejected while this is empty.

input-field.name: defaultSmsProvider
input-field.label: Default SMS provider
Standard-SMS-Anbieter
input-field.helpText:
Tried first for every message. If it is unavailable, the remaining configured providers are tried in turn, preferring one that covers the destination country. A provider with no credentials is skipped entirely.
Deliberately unset by default: choosing a default is picking who carries your customers' messages, and that should be an explicit decision rather than one this plugin makes for you. With none chosen, the first configured provider that covers the destination is used.

input-field.name: defaultDialCode
input-field.label: Default country dial code
Standard-Landesvorwahl
input-field.helpText: Used to expand national numbers such as "0803…" into international form. Numbers already starting with "+" or "00" are left alone. If this is empty, national numbers are skipped rather than guessed at.

input-field.name: termiiApiKey
input-field.label: API key
API-Schlüssel
input-field.helpText: From the Termii dashboard. Leave empty to disable Termii.

input-field.name: termiiSenderId
input-field.label: Sender ID
Absender-ID
input-field.helpText: The approved alphanumeric sender your messages appear from. Termii rejects messages sent from an unapproved sender.

input-field.name: termiiRoute
input-field.label: Carrier route
Carrier-Route
input-field.helpText: "Generic" is the standard route; "DND" is required to reach Nigerian numbers on the do-not-disturb list and is charged differently.

input-field.name: termiiBaseUrl
input-field.label: API base URL
API-Basis-URL
input-field.helpText: Optional. Defaults to https://v3.api.termii.com — override only if Termii assigned your account a different regional host.

input-field.name: sendexaApiToken
input-field.label: API token
API-Token
input-field.helpText: The Base64 token from your Sendexa dashboard, pasted as shown. Leave empty to disable Sendexa.

input-field.name: sendexaSenderId
input-field.label: Sender ID
Absender-ID
input-field.helpText: The approved sender your messages appear from. Sendexa allows at most 11 characters.

input-field.name: sendexaBaseUrl
input-field.label: API base URL
API-Basis-URL
input-field.helpText: Optional. Defaults to https://api.sendexa.co — override only if Sendexa assigned your account a different host.

input-field.name: africasTalkingUsername
input-field.label: Username
Benutzername
input-field.helpText: Your account username. The literal value "sandbox" switches this provider to the Africa's Talking sandbox environment.

input-field.name: africasTalkingApiKey
input-field.label: API key
API-Schlüssel
input-field.helpText: From the Africa's Talking dashboard. Leave empty to disable this provider.

input-field.name: africasTalkingSenderId
input-field.label: Sender ID or short code
Absender-ID oder Kurzwahl
input-field.helpText: Optional. Leave empty to send from the shared sender pool.

input-field.name: twilioAccountSid
input-field.label: Account SID
input-field.helpText: Starts with "AC". Leave empty to disable Twilio.

input-field.name: twilioMessagingServiceSid
input-field.label: Messaging service SID
input-field.helpText: Optional. Starts with "MG". If set, it replaces the sending number and Twilio picks the sender from that service's pool.

input-field.name: enableDebugging
input-field.label: Enable debug logging
Debug-Protokollierung aktivieren
input-field.helpText: Writes debug, info and warning entries to var/log/kommandhub_sms_*.log. Errors are always logged regardless of this setting. Can be scoped to a single sales channel.
Schreibt Debug-, Info- und Warnungseinträge nach var/log/kommandhub_sms_*.log. Fehler werden unabhängig von dieser Einstellung immer protokolliert.

input-field.name: logLevels
input-field.label: Log levels
Protokollstufen
input-field.helpText: Restrict debug logging to specific PSR-3 levels. Leave empty to log every level once debug logging is enabled.
